diagram_math_checks.result: P=P(E) in quotient convention. Phi_d maps the direct sum of A_{d+i}(X), 0<=i<=r-1, to A_{d+r-1}(P), exactly the Statement. Local flat-pullback supplier raises degree by r-1; local first-Chern-class definition lowers degree by i under xi^i. Thus every summand reaches the common target.

The local proper-pushforward supplier Statement (1) gives A_m(P) -> A_m(X). Consequently the right arrow is A_{d+r-1}(P) -> A_{d+r-1}(X), and the left projection has the same target. The erroneous candidate A_d(X) codomain was not adopted.

Step 1.1 gives pi_*(xi^i cap pi^* alpha_i)=0 for i<r-1 and alpha_{r-1} for i=r-1. Additivity therefore proves pi_* Phi_d = pr_{r-1}; the lower equality identifies two copies of A_{d+r-1}(X). Phi_d is an isomorphism by steps 2.1, 2.2 and 3.1.

For r=1, the unique i=0 summand yields pi_*pi^*=id as step 1.1 states. For higher rank the diagram extracts only alpha_{r-1}; successive extraction in the zero relation follows step 2.1 after previously detected coefficients vanish. No claim that one pushforward extracts all coefficients, no smoothness of X, and no codimension-grading assumption were added.
